issues.reason: Coordination & plurals translates coordinated VPs 'independently, as if written as separate sentences (a shared subject carries over to each conjunct)' — only the subject and the fronted 'On day 34 of Year 1' frame reach the second conjunct, so 'at dawn', which sits inside the first VP, puts a time on the carrying that the text never states (Core patterns: point at the words that put the atom there).

gaps_confirmed: Container / measure of-phrase ('twelve full buckets of salt-bloom'): a measure 'of' is explicitly excluded from the genitive Possession mapping and no positive encoding is named anywhere, so the container-to-contents link has no licensed form (the parse's entity-attached (Of …) is acceptable improvisation — true and well-typed — not a defect).

Day-of-year dating ('on day 34 of Year 1'): (Day <n>) is the month-day slot that composes with (Month <name>), so a numbered day of a year has no well-formed term, and an ordinal era year has no form distinguishing it from a calendar year.
defect_summary: The compliant form drops (Time sk_carry_1 dawn) and leaves the carrying event with only the sentence-frame time atoms (Time sk_carry_1 (Day 34)) and (Time sk_carry_1 (Year 1)), the frame adverbial being the only time the second conjunct states.
notes: Everything else matches the instruction set as written: the distributive 'full' rule over the bucket group, the motion-result Theme+Goal on 'poured … into', the each-compartment universal with its QuantifierPhrase companion, and the stayed-potent continuation copular (reified state + Still + flat atom + tense). The defect is a single over-asserted adjunct, not a structural failure.
